dedupe_keys.name: stationnement payant en voirie a montpellier

description: Stationnement payant en voirie à Montpellier is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by TAM. Cette donnée renseigne la tarification en vigueur par rue selon les trois zones de stationnement (verte, orange et jaune) et les secteurs de stationnement relatifs au stationnement résidentiel. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are stationement, voirie, parking, tarif, voiture, Montpellier. The portal shows 1,500 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
